verdict.why: The Right build has a mossy stone base with lanterns, dark timber-framed upper storeys with white infill, a glowing orange window, and a teal conical roof, so it reads as the brief's wizard tower, while the Left build is a plain purple-trimmed stone shaft with a pointed cap and none of the timber, lanterns, glow, or jetties; the Right roof is lumpy in places, which keeps the craft win from being decisive.
